title: UNDERBODY-NO. 4 BODY MOUNT REINF & REAR COMPT LAMP BRACKET
summary: Rear underbody: the vertical reinforcement on the car centerline at the back wall of the rear storage compartment with the rear compartment lamp bracket riveted to it, the No. 4 body mount (body bolt) reinforcements (LH/RH) under the floor behind the seats, and on convertibles the folding top hinge support reinforcements riveted above them. Everything is riveted to the fiberglass underbody; a retainer with a nut is shown in View A.
